tagline: Local STIHL and power equipment specialists
heroSubheading: STIHL batteries, Masport mowers, and the advice to match.
aboutHtml:
Philip and Karen have owned STIHL SHOP Ellerslie since 2016. We specialise in STIHL battery electric tools and also carry Masport, Gravely, Cub Cadet, Rover, Victa, and Hansa. Whether you're buying new or need support with equipment you already have, we're here with friendly advice and proper service.

We know Ellerslie and what works for local gardens and outdoor spaces. Come to us for sales, servicing, parts, and the right gear matched to your needs. We've got the know-how to help you make the right choice.

We're part of this community. We support local primary schools, sports clubs, and Safety-Wise initiatives. We're here for you and your gear. Visit us weekdays from 8am, Saturday from 9am, or Sunday from 10am.
servicesIntro: We service and support all your power equipment.
